$comment: PL-06 ground truth. The six defects deliberately planted in Meridian, transcribed from
docs/01-PRD-v2.md §9.1. This file is the evaluation harness's answer key and lives here,
with the app that contains the defects, rather than inside the harness — a score is only
meaningful if the answers were written down before the run and can be diffed independently
of the code that grades against them.
`expectedSignature` is the FindingSignature from PRD §6.5 that the §9.1 'expected signal'
maps to. `route` is the URL pathname the defect lives on; a defect is matched to a finding
by (expectedSignature + route) and never by the finding's wording (CLAUDE.md §6.5 — text
matching would let a reworded explanation change the score).
Never 'fix' these. They are the test fixture (PRD §9.1).

defects.description: Primary CTA below the fold, no scroll cue
Two competing CTAs; "Continue" is a no-op
Validation error at 1.11:1 contrast, present on screen but never announced
defects.prdExpectedSignal: error-text contrast + Loop; screen-reader segment fails
